memory.title: Memory
memory.description: What {{project}}'s agents remember across tasks. Only active records reach agents; records they propose wait here for you.
memory.settingsUnbuilt: Project settings › Memory isn't built yet: the saving rules and limits can't be changed in this version.
memory.loadFailedBody: {{reason}} Nothing was changed; agents keep working with what their prompts already hold.

meta.withdrawn: replaced by its newer proposal before anyone decided

proposal.note: Agents don't receive it until you approve.

noMatch.lexical: Search finds words and parts of words in the text, keys and tags of records. It doesn't know synonyms, so try another word.

editor.newSubtitle: A record you write for {{project}}'s agents
editor.saveToHint: A record a person writes is active at once.
editor.pinned: Pinned · always give it to agents
editor.pinnedHint: Pinned records reach every invocation of their memory before any match, within the record and token limits.
editor.replacesText: It becomes superseded and stops reaching agents; its history stays with this record.
editor.confidenceValue: {{confidence}} · set by {{agent}}; people don't change it
editor.author: Author
editor.authorKept: your edit keeps the author and adds edited by you
editor.rejectNote: Rejected proposals are kept and never given.
editor.approveNote: Your edits are saved with the approval.
editor.saveNote: Changes reach agents from their next invocation.

delete.title: Delete this record?
delete.givenNone: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation; no invocation was given it.
delete.givenOne: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation, and the invocation that was given it shows Deleted record.
delete.givenOther: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation, and the {{count}} invocations that were given it show Deleted record.
delete.givenUnknown: It stops reaching agents from their next invocation, and invocations that were given it show Deleted record.
delete.earlierOne: Its 1 earlier version is deleted with it.
delete.earlierOther: Its {{count}} earlier versions are deleted with it.
delete.deprecateHint: To stop giving it to agents but keep it and its history, deprecate it instead.

unreadable.one: 1 record couldn't be read and is left out
unreadable.other: {{count}} records couldn't be read and are left out
unreadable.body: They are missing from this list, from search and from what agents get. The project database keeps their rows as they are.

empty.title: No project memory yet
empty.body: Agents propose what matters beyond one task: which database {{project}} uses, how API errors are shaped, a test that is flaky on Windows. Records they propose wait here for you; a record you write is active at once.
empty.savingBoth: Project and task memory save after approval · {{records}} records, {{tokens}} tokens per agent
empty.savingNeither: Project and task memory save automatically · {{records}} records, {{tokens}} tokens per agent
empty.savingProject: Project memory saves after approval, task memory automatically · {{records}} records, {{tokens}} tokens per agent
empty.savingTask: Task memory saves after approval, project memory automatically · {{records}} records, {{tokens}} tokens per agent

queue.title: Waiting for approval
queue.note: Agents get a record from their next invocation after you approve it.
queue.noneBody: Records agents propose for {{project}} and its tasks wait here until you approve or reject them.

panel.title: Project memory
panel.name: {{project}} · shared by every task
panel.givenNote: Agents get active records only: their task's latest handoff, pinned records, decisions and warnings, then the best matches for their step.
panel.peopleNote: Agents propose and supersede records. Only people approve, edit, deprecate or delete them.

inspector.author: Author
inspector.givenNone: No invocation was given it yet.
inspector.deprecated: Agents no longer get it. It keeps its history and can be restored.
inspector.deprecatedKeyed: Agents no longer get it. It keeps its history and can be restored while its key {{key}} is free.
inspector.rejected: It was never given to agents. A rejected proposal is never restored; if it turns out true, an agent proposes it again or you write a new record.

next.title: Next agent receives
next.chosen: Chosen the way the next prompt is built.
next.chosenFor: Chosen the way {{agent}}'s next prompt is built.
next.recordLimitOne: The record limit left out 1 lower-ranked match.
next.recordLimit: The record limit left out {{count}} lower-ranked matches.
next.tokenLimitOne: The token limit left out 1 lower-ranked match.
next.tokenLimit: The token limit left out {{count}} lower-ranked matches.
next.nothing: Nothing to give yet: the next prompt has no Task memory part. No project record matches this task.
next.none: No agent step of this task works or waits to start, so nothing is chosen for one.
next.unreadable: Can't show what the next agent receives until task memory can be read.
next.footnote: Ranked by matching words, importance, recency, role and confidence. Waiting proposals are never given.

task.emptyTitle: No memory for this task yet
task.emptyBody: Agents keep a handoff when a step passes or fails, with the decisions it made; you can write records too.
task.emptyWorking: {{step}} is working: its handoff appears here when the step ends.
task.loadFailedBody: {{reason}} Nothing was changed; agents keep working with what their prompts already hold.
